title: Trigonometry Calculator
description: Compute sin, cos, tan, csc, sec, cot for any angle in degrees or radians, plus inverse trig from a value.
howto: Enter the angle and pick degrees or radians.
Press Calculate for all six trig functions.
Use the inverse section to get arcsin, arccos or arctan of a value.

faqs.q: When are csc, sec or cot undefined?
faqs.a: When their reciprocal is zero: csc at 0°/180°, sec at 90°/270°, cot at 0°/180°.
Values from −1 to 1 only, since sine never leaves that range; arctan accepts any real number.
Inverse trig returns one standard angle: arcsin in [−90°, 90°], arccos in [0°, 180°], arctan in (−90°, 90°).
